The term "acid" has been used as a common name for d-LSD since the 1960s. Although confusion associated with newer psychoactive substances has lead some people to use the term "acid" to refer to anything LSD-like or anything psychedelic on blotter or sold in drops, we believe this represents an error and not a useful evolution in language.]
I first tried eth-lad (I'm already quite familiar with 1p or ald52), and I can say that I will not do it again. What a nightmare
What torture
What torture
I'm alive?
I hope so, yes, I still doubt it.
200ug of eth-lad isn't 200ug of other acid, for sure!!!
00:00 took 2 x 100ug eth lad bottle [blotter?]
At the beginning is very funny, it took almost 1 hour and a half to start feeling the first effects
it took almost 1 hour and a half to start feeling the first effects
(for more than an hour I was suspicious of having bought spoiled acids), but as soon as it starts to beat, oh my god.
I was alone, and I did not die.
When I began to enjoy the changes of visuals with crossed and alternative thoughts, I decided to take a walk at night near my house. When I realized I was away from home (something like 7 minutes on foot), the world began to fall apart. It was no fun to keep my eyes open, because the visions were so aggressive, so hallucinated and exaggerated that I began to feel like vomiting and at the same time afraid to continue or not overcome.
3 hours or more was when the peak came. Shooting stars flew all over my vision. The colors were more alive than ever. Patterns of symmetry began to appear everywhere, with scary flashes. I had to concentrate really hard not to fall over or throw up.
And it was here that it began for about 2 hours, an internal journey to my head, where I completely lost contact with reality. Every 10 seconds, everything started again, there were times when I could reconnect with reality, but it lasted very little time, and I was always sucked back into the repetitive tunnel of thoughts completely out of touch with reality.
Only at 05:30 did I get back to 'reality'
200 ug of eth lad, its just to much!!!!!!!! I have never experienced such confusion with lsd like this.
